scope: The retained artist exterior has smoother shoulder attachment weights, with rigid distal flipper anchors. Original positions, normals, UVs, embedded images, morph targets and animation curves are retained. This reduces pinching during the existing paired-flipper study. Residual shoulder/body contour and foot/neck swimming-morph limitations remain; this is not anatomical or physiological validation.

method.units: normalized artist coordinates; not measured anatomical dimensions

validation: Technical and visual regression checks only. All biological partial/unavailable labels retained.
